title: Add measured Sigma 20–200 mm Sony E distortion and vignetting profile (TCA unsupported)
source: mpasson/RapidRAW (calibration data CC-BY-SA 3.0); scoped RapidRoom adaptation with Codex
notes: Retains 51 corrected poly5 distortion anchors and 99 PA-vignetting entries measured from 207 ILCE-7CM2 ARWs. Unsupported polynomial TCA is excluded from the active profile and named in the selector; unchanged licensed donor data is retained for a separate evaluator issue. Existing Lens controls opt into correction; defaults and legacy stored coefficients are unchanged. Synthetic validation only: unvalidated on real lens files in RapidRoom.
